author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.60 shipped: Bathroom exhaust: smell rule, venting independent of room switch, no resend spam
summary: Bathroom exhaust: smell rule, venting independent of room switch, no resend spam
why: Master Bathroom fan got 3,806 redundant turn_on calls in 7 days; Ziri Bathroom never vented because its room switch was off; the 2026-08 cycle copied only the run-on half of the operator's toilet automation, so no smell-driven fan existed. Measured raw-sensor visit lengths (median 34-40 s) to set a 60 s dwell on the raw sensor, not URA's 5-min room timer. Reviews caught a non-callback listener running off the event loop, a stuck-sensor cap bypass, sleep-off fighting a hand-on fan, and 17 untested sites, all fixed with drills.
implications: Shipped HUMIDITY-FAN-ON-RESEND-SPAM-1 at v5.103.60; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.60.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: recorder: Master Bathroom fan homeassistant.turn_on calls per humid hour <= 3, and a Powder or Master Toilet raw-sensor ON-run over 90 s followed by a fan ON within 30 s

refs.release_notes: Occupancy-dwell (60 s raw sensor) turns exhaust on for long visits incl. rooms without a humidity sensor; humidity venting gated only by the humidity-fan switch; transition-gated writes with 180 s re-assert and 30 min manual-off respect. Tier 2-DB, three reviews, name-diff clean.
